label: Совсем
description: A 10-sentence usage card for совсем (completely, at all).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Completeness with a verb. 'Совсем' means completely or totally, here intensifying 'забыл' to mean utterly forgot. It stands before the verb it scales.
Strategic focus: Scaling an adjective. 'Совсем' boosts 'другое' to mean an entirely different matter. It precedes the adjective and conveys a full, absolute degree.
Strategic focus: Совсем with negation. Paired with 'не', the phrase 'совсем не' means not at all, a total negation. The particle sits before 'не' to strengthen the denial.
Strategic focus: Impersonal state. 'Совсем' intensifies the predicative 'темно' to mean completely dark. It precedes the state word in this impersonal construction.
Strategic focus: Adjective in a noun phrase. 'Совсем' scales 'молодая' to mean very young indeed, almost a child. It stays before the adjective it modifies.
Strategic focus: Reinforcing absence. With the negative existential 'нет', 'совсем' stresses a total lack, meaning no time at all. It precedes 'нет' for emphasis.
Strategic focus: Scaling another adverb. 'Совсем' intensifies the adverb 'близко' to mean very close, right nearby. It directly precedes the adverb it modifies.
Strategic focus: Total negation of an action. 'Совсем не' before 'спал' means did not sleep at all during the night. The pairing creates an absolute, emphatic negative.
Strategic focus: Predicate adjective. 'Совсем' pushes 'холодный' to full degree, meaning the tea is completely cold. It is a neutral, very common everyday intensifier.
Strategic focus: Scaling a time adverb. 'Совсем' tightens 'недавно' to mean only very recently. It precedes the adverb and narrows the time frame to a short span.
